# Purpose

This script demonstrates a simple data analysis workflow in R using a synthetic dataset.

# Inputs

The script creates a small dataset containing student names and scores.

# Processing Steps

1. Load required packages
2. Create a sample dataset
3. Generate summary statistics
4. Export results to a CSV file

# Code Example

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

data <- data.frame(
  Name = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
  Score = c(80, 90, 75, 85)
)

summary(data)
```

# Outputs

- Summary statistics
- summary_results.csv

# Notes

This project uses synthetic data for educational purposes.
